info.description:
Persistent chat rooms, Blast, @mentions, search, typing and unread counts, plus a bot API (streams, subscribe, post as bot, push to composer). Behaviour modelled on institutional chat; the API shape and look are our own.

**Simulator for demonstration only. Not affiliated with or endorsed by EquiLend, Wematch, FIS, S3 Partners or Bloomberg; all names are trademarks of their respective owners. Listed instruments come from public reference data (OpenFIGI, Yahoo Finance); lending data, counterparties and trades are synthetic.**
